---
description: "Use when editing HTML, CSS, or vanilla JavaScript for this project. Keep pages semantic, lightweight, and framework-free with practical Flexbox/Grid layouts."
name: "Lightweight Static Site Rules"
applyTo: "**/*.{html,css,js}"
---
# Lightweight Static Site Rules

- Prefer semantic HTML elements before adding extra wrappers.
- Keep CSS straightforward and easy to scan; favor Flexbox or Grid for layout.
- Avoid frameworks, heavy abstractions, and unnecessary architecture.
- Use vanilla JavaScript only where behavior cannot be handled cleanly with HTML/CSS.
- Make focused changes and preserve existing structure unless refactoring is requested.
